reviewed.readme:
🎨 dsh-opencode-palette

**🌐 [中文](../README.md) · [English](README.en.md)** **38 themes for DSH, one click.** *38 款配色，一键给 DSH 换装。* Your ⭐ is the brightest star in my night sky. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-opencode-palette?label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-opencode-palette) [![downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/dsh-opencode-palette?label=downloads&color=red)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-opencode-palette) [![last-commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/FeatherHunter/dsh-opencode-palette?label=last-commit&color=FE7D37)](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-opencode-palette/commits/main) [![themes](https://img.shields.io/badge/themes-OpenCode%C2%B738-9D7CD8)](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode) [![Issues welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/Issues%20welcome-brightgreen.svg)](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-opencode-palette/issues)

INSTALL
Get started in three steps

```bash # 1. install the DSH CLI first (skip if you have it) npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh # 2. add the plugin to your profile dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-opencode-palette # 3. restart DSH once it's installed (or refresh the browser page) ``` **① Install the plugin.** **② Open “OpenCode Palette”.** Settings → Plugins → OpenCode Palette **③ Pick a theme you like.**

EXTENSIONS
What the OpenCode themes come with

**Fonts on their own.** Color is color, fonts are fonts, and the two never collide: Mono (terminal look) turns the whole interface monospaced, Regular (interface look) applies monospace to code blocks only; size 11–24 px, and you can pick the code font from the fonts installed on this machine. Saved changes survive a restart. **A panel that speaks your DSH.** DSH is in Chinese, so the panel is too; switch DSH to English and the panel follows. **Your own palette.** 37 slots, one at a time, with a miniature DSH preview on the right: click an element in the preview and the matching row on the left scrolls to the middle and opens the color picker; hover a slot on the left and that element lights up in the preview. 25 IP presets work as bases, and saved themes land in `/opencode-palette/custom-themes/`.

UPGRADE
Upgrade

```bash dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-opencode-palette # pin to an older version: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-opencode-palette@ ``` Don't want to type commands? The panel has a button too: Settings → Plugins → OpenCode Palette, with a **Check for updates** at the right of the title row — it only goes online when you click it. When a newer version exists, that button turns into “Update available vX.Y.Z” right there; click to open the panel, then install. It takes effect after a DSH restart — until you do, a banner stays at the top of the panel.

MORE
More from the author

If you like this plugin, these might be useful too: **[dsh-prompt](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-prompt)** — The few prompts you type every day, saved as templates: one click drops the whole thing into your input box (24 prebuilt, and you can save your own) **[dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck)** — The whole mattpocock/skills set (nearly 300k stars) preinstalled — 27 skills covering TDD, bug diagnosis, specs, code review; ready as soon as it's installed **[dsh-im-companion](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-im-companion)** — Adds the ideas of an “assistant” and a “home” to dsh-im: which workspace has an assistant on duty, which conversation group went wrong — the left rail shows it at a glance (install dsh-im first)

THANKS
Contributors

[@oopsdoes](https://github.com/oopsdoes) — #46 proposed light-mode following for opaque themes (the half #45 deferred) 🌹; #55 caught follow-system persisting as dark 🌹 [@gitwch1](https://github.com/gitwch1) — #73 found no repro on a fresh install, suggesting a missed DSH restart or a second theme plugin double-overriding 🌹 [@anci3ntr0ck](https://github.com/anci3ntr0ck) — #73 reported diff rows unreadable across most themes: tints sitting on the text, Nord a solid block 🌹 [@SRKBob](https://github.com/SRKBob) — #43 found the whites too harsh and asked for a softer palette 🌹 [@anupamme](https://github.com/anupamme) — #32 flagged a missing check on theme downloads 🌹 [@Number444](https://github.com/Number444) — #12 asked for Maple Mono NF CN 2:1 CJK 🌹 [@xiSage](https://github.com/xiSage) — #11 asked for any system font; the panel now lists your local fonts 🌹 [@the-beating-light-of-the-nail](https://github.com/the-beating-light-of-the-nail) — #3 listed this plugin in DSH Meme Hub with palette notes 🌹

CONNECT
Feedback & Contact

Found a bug or have an idea? Just [open an issue](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-opencode-palette/issues). And if you'd rather talk it over, scan the code to join the **DSH plugin community group**.
